mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 3.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change < 0 AND INDPRO monthly change < 0
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year) prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls below 50,000 signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS monthly change is below 50,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market slowdowns (HOUST < 1400 thousand units), consumer spending weakens, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1400, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 3.6%) signals a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE > 3.6%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing and supply chain activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
